label: Symbolic Rule Evidence Schema
description: Reusable Prolog-style rule/evidence vocabulary extracted from the legacy ARC3 rule prompt.
text: Represent established regularities separately from hypotheses and evidence.
A useful Prolog-oriented vocabulary is observed_rule/2, hypothetical_rule/3, evidence/3, supported_by/2, contradicted_by/2, and confidence/2.
Evidence should cite concrete state or transition facts rather than restating the hypothesis.
Do not promote a hypothesis to an observed rule from one ambiguous coincidence.
